newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokio Marine to sell U.S. unit to Commercial Union.
newsitem.headline: Tokio Marine to sell U.S. unit to Commercial Union.

text.p: Tokio Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to sell its U.S. subsidiary to Britain's Commercial Union Plc.
The transaction is expected to be completed by the end of September, subject to approval from related authorities, Toko Marine said in a statement.

A spokesman at Tokio Marine, Japan's leading non-life insurance company, said the two sides have not yet agreed on the price of its medium-sized U.S. subsidiary, Houston General Insurance Co, which is capitalised at $10 million.
"We will start discussing details from now on," he said.
Tokio Marine took over the U.S. firm in 1980, he said.
The company said in the statement it will continue operating insurance business in the United States through another subsidiary there called Tokio Marine Management.
